eligibility: LGBTQ+ young people anywhere in the United States.
cost: Free
application_steps: Call, text START to 678678, or chat.
what_to_bring: Ask them what to bring when you call.

title: Trans Lifeline
description: Peer-support hotline run by and for trans people, offering confidential emotional support and crisis help without police involvement; available by phone nationwide.
eligibility: Trans and questioning people. Peer support, run by trans people.
cost: Free
application_steps: Does not call police or emergency services without your consent.
what_to_bring: Ask them what to bring when you call.

title: American Indian College Fund Scholarships
description: Provides merit-based scholarships (averaging $2,000-$3,000) to American Indian and Alaska Native students in certificate, undergraduate, and graduate programs, with one application covering all opportunities each cycle (opens Feb 1, priority deadline May 31). Foster care experience is not a specifically listed eligibility factor, but Native youth with a foster care background can apply through the same general process.
eligibility: Foster care experience is not a specifically listed eligibility factor, but Native youth with a foster care background can apply through the same general process.
cost: Not confirmed yet — ask what it costs.
application_steps: Call 303-426-8900 and ask how to start and whether you qualify.
what_to_bring: Ask them what to bring when you call.
